summary.headline: Bright Fixed Stars in Nativities
summary.text: Astrological discussion of fortunate nativities despite unfavorable placements, attributed to bright fixed stars co-rising with the angles or Moon. The author explains the omission of Canopus, refers to earlier testimonies on ancient authors, and begins treating the powers and activities of lesser stars.
